translations.changes: Amudi escaped HTML and divided existing source text into reading sections of at most 900 words before loading, preserving every source word in order. These are Amudi reading divisions, not canonical simanim or printed dapim. Amudi performed no OCR or translation. Copyrightable adaptations remain CC BY-SA 4.0.
translations.coverageStatus: All 63 supplied text files, numbered 8–70, from the responsa opening identifying Isaac Alfasi through the closing discussion of prayer. Front matter before file 8 is not supplied. This is the historical Hebrew recension, not a claim to include every surviving Alfasi responsum or its original Judeo-Arabic wording. Existing automatically digitized text was sampled for identity and coherence; possible word/reference errors remain. No English translation is included.
